_comment: Tidewater issue-label palette for the Lentago Labs fleet, applied by
terraform/labels.tf on merge to main. Colors mirror site-lentago-dev/BRAND.md;
that repo's design-system CSS is authoritative if they ever disagree.
Every label here goes on every repo, except two kinds that only mean
something where their automation runs: the model:* @claude routing labels,
which a repo opts into through repos.json's model_labels, and a label that
carries a 'repos' list, which goes on exactly those repos and nowhere else.
Labels not listed here are left completely alone: per-repo labels like
'zha' or 'phase-1' are the repo's own business, not fleet branding.
Accent discipline (BRAND.md): anther gold #E0A81C is one element per
region. 'help wanted' is the fleet's single gold label — it is the only
one that is a call to action.
'epic' marks a tracking issue whose sub-issues are the work; the Epics
report (fleet-reports/epics.md) discovers epics by it and by sub-issues.
'token-rotation' is the deliberate override for betula's token rotation
guard (lentago/betula#119): its plan guard fails any plan that updates or
deletes an Axiom token unless the PR carries this label. Scoped to betula;
another repo whose guard honours it joins by adding itself to 'repos'.
Narrowing a scope deletes: a repo dropped from 'repos' (or from
model_labels) loses the label, and every issue and PR there loses it too.
